description: CN receiving scan partial flag (CR-047) is silently dropped at finalize on an untouched line, and a flag qty smaller than the true shortfall leaves units unaccounted: finalize's received_qty CASE only credits an error line when flag_qty IS NOT NULL AND scan_qty > 0, so flagging e.g. 40 short on a 100-qty line with nothing scanned (flag_qty=40, scan_qty NULL) receives 0 — the 60 un-flagged units vanish; likewise scan 60 of 100 then flag 20 leaves 20 units neither received nor flagged (received = min(scan_qty, line_qty) regardless of flag_qty)
reproSteps: Scan task with a 100-qty line: (a) without scanning, open Flag, enter 40, confirm → line shows error; press 完成 → received_qty = 0 for that line (expected: 60, or reject the partial flag when nothing was scanned). (b) scan 60, flag 20 → finalize receives 60 and flags only 20; the remaining 20 of the line is unaccounted (expected: remainder auto-flagged missing, or flag qty restricted to the full shortfall)
remarks: Found while investigating the UAT report 「flag qty smaller than the part qty has no effect」. Verified at HTTP level that the current backend (commit 3f6af0dc) accepts a smaller flag qty in both scenarios (untouched line flag 40 of 100 → 200; scan 60/100 flag 20 → 200) and the PDA distribution loop in pages/receiving-cn-scan/[id].vue is correct on HEAD — the reported button symptom could not be reproduced on current code; if it persists on UAT, check the deployed backend is built from ≥3f6af0dc (flag_qty column + qty validation) and capture the toast/backend log. This finalize-gap defect is real on HEAD: apps/backend/src/db/receivingCnScan.ts finalizeCnScanTask received_qty CASE ignores flag_qty when scan_qty = 0 and never accounts for shortfall minus flag_qty
